config.transforms: 8 dihedral transforms (4 rotations x flip) of the input window; probability maps mapped back; std across the 8
config.lexicographic: boundary patches (indicator > 0) first ordered by confidence midrank, then interior by confidence midrank

prereg.dihedral: vs confidence: one vote per river (A), per-tile sign test (B); U+ = midrank mean of confidence and dihedral
prereg.lexicographic: capture at 5% and 10% vs confidence: per-tile one-sided sign tests on Bolivia, task bootstrap on AWF

Bolivia is one flood event; per-tile signs are descriptive, not an exact test
